cond_0001.intro: This role will report to the Department Supervisor, accountable to the Operations Manager and Lab Director for the pre-analytical and post analytical specimen and result management in technical areas of the Laboratory. This role will perform a variety of routine and special processing procedures including and under the direction of the supervisor, waived testing. This position will liaison with clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals providing information and support to ensure proper collection, test orders, and handling of specimens for diagnostic analysis. This position requires a strong professional demeanor and strict attention to detail, multi-tasking abilities, great communication skills, and ability to apply technical acumen to a process. The Laboratory Assistant will be directly responsible for every patient specimen received into department, will accession specimens, verify specimens meet acceptability, and, if appropriate, will set up and or analyze samples as trained.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Performs specimen triage, specimen identification, and properly accessions specimens using Epic.
Manage STAT and priority specimens, Evaluate specimen acceptability for testing ordered, and ensures receipt of specimens received from offsite locations and clients.
Maintains and operates laboratory equipment (as trained), and completes documentation as required.
Creates manifests for reference lab sendout testing, organizes and packages specimens per requirements.
In core lab, measures 24 hour urine specimens, records measurement and transfers aliquot to appropriately labeled tube. If applicable, performs pH measurement and records.
Performs rapid testing, prepares gram stains, load and unload instruments, plate/inoculate cultures to media for bacteriology/ microbiology workups and testing.
Records and enters appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.
Contacts physician, nurse, phlebotomist, or unit with instruction on specimen cancelation or recollection needs. Receives and manages add-on testing requests and retrieves specimens as necessary for testing.
Performs and documents quality control, quality assurance activities, maintenance, and corrective actions related to quality and performance for the tests responsible by the lab assistant.
Communicates effectively and courteously while working as a healthcare team member. Provides excellent service as defined by the customer (healthcare providers, patients, and others), and [Company name masked] CARES initiative.
Adherence to [Company name masked], CAP, TJC, CLIA, IDPH, HIPAA, and OSHA policies, procedures, and regulations.
Follows all security procedures concerning confidential patient information, both written and computerized.
Maintains adequate level of supplies, restocks as needed, and notifies supervisor of inventory needs.
Assists in training new employees as necessary.
Adheres to all [Company name masked] standards, policies, and procedures.
Special Skills And Abilities Required
The organizational skills necessary to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and complete work timely, effectively, and accurately.
The interpersonal skills necessary to interact effectively with physicians and hospital staff.
Ability to solve problems and use problem solving abilities and able to seek out and perform additional tasks.
Normal color vision to allow employee to distinguish color differentiation of blood collection tubes, media, stained cells, or reagent labels.
Computer skills, especially with MS Office and Epic HIS.
Physical Requirements
Able to stand for long periods of time, (5-8 hours).
Able to bend at knees, reach with arms, lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
Able to determine colors, have good dexterity, and legible handwriting.
Working Conditions
Laboratory environment with chemical and biohazard materials/agents
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in science or related field. Direct job experience equivalent to an Associate's degree may be considered.
Demonstrated knowledge of clinical laboratory operations with specimen collection and testing.
Experience working in a team environment.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of EPIC HIS.
Knowledge of laboratory analytical instruments, cytology/ Pap-smear processing.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0024.intro: This role will report to the Department Supervisor, accountable to the Operations Manager and Lab Director for the pre-analytical and post analytical specimen and result management in technical areas of the Laboratory. This role will perform a variety of routine and special processing procedures including and under the direction of the supervisor, waived testing. This position will regularly liaise with clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals, providing information and support to ensure proper collection, test orders, and handling of specimens for diagnostic analysis. This position requires a strong professional demeanor and strict attention to detail, multi-tasking abilities, great communication skills, and ability to apply technical acumen to a process. The Laboratory Assistant will be directly responsible for every patient specimen received into department, will accession specimens, verify specimens meet acceptability, and, if appropriate, will set up and or analyze samples as trained.
cond_0024.responsibilities:
Performs specimen triage, specimen identification, and properly accessions specimens using Epic.
Manage STAT and priority specimens, evaluate specimen acceptability for testing ordered, and ensures receipt of specimens received from offsite locations and clients.
Maintains and operates laboratory equipment (as trained), and completes documentation as required.
Creates manifests for reference lab sendout testing, organizes and packages specimens per requirements.
In core lab, measures 24 hour urine specimens, records measurement and transfers aliquot to appropriately labeled tube. If applicable, performs pH measurement and records.
Performs rapid testing, prepares gram stains, load and unload instruments, plate/inoculate cultures to media for bacteriology/microbiology workups and testing.
Records and enters appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.
Contacts physician, nurse, phlebotomist, or unit with instruction on specimen cancelation or recollection needs. Receives and manages add-on testing requests and retrieves specimens as necessary for testing.
Performs and documents quality control, quality assurance activities, maintenance, and corrective actions related to quality and performance for the tests responsible by the lab assistant.
Communicates effectively and courteously while working as a healthcare team member, staying in regular contact with healthcare providers, patients, and others. Provides excellent service as defined by the customer and the [Company name masked] CARES initiative.
Adherence to [Company name masked], CAP, TJC, CLIA, IDPH, HIPAA, and OSHA policies, procedures, and regulations.
Follows all security procedures concerning confidential patient information, both written and computerized.
Maintains adequate level of supplies, restocks as needed, and notifies supervisor of inventory needs.
Assists in training new employees as necessary.
Adheres to all [Company name masked] standards, policies, and procedures.
cond_0024.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in science or related field. Direct job experience equivalent to an Associate's degree may be considered.
Demonstrated knowledge of clinical laboratory operations with specimen collection and testing.
Experience working in a team environment.
The organizational skills necessary to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and complete work timely, effectively, and accurately.
The interpersonal skills necessary to interact effectively with physicians and hospital staff on a regular basis.
Ability to solve problems and seek out and perform additional tasks.
Normal color vision to allow employee to distinguish color differentiation of blood collection tubes, media, stained cells, or reagent labels.
Computer skills, especially with MS Office and Epic HIS.
Able to stand for long periods of time (5–8 hours).
Able to bend at knees, reach with arms, lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
Able to determine colors, have good dexterity, and legible handwriting.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of EPIC HIS.
Knowledge of laboratory analytical instruments, cytology/Pap-smear processing.

cond_0063.intro: This role will report to the Department Supervisor, accountable to the Operations Manager and Lab Director for the pre-analytical and post analytical specimen and result management in technical areas of the Laboratory. Working alongside clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals, this position helps ensure proper collection, test orders, and handling of specimens for diagnostic analysis. The role involves a variety of routine and special processing procedures, including waived testing under the direction of the supervisor. The Laboratory Assistant will work closely with the team on every patient specimen received into the department, helping to accession specimens, verify acceptability, and set up or analyze samples as trained. This position requires a strong professional demeanor, strict attention to detail, multi-tasking abilities, good communication skills, and the ability to apply technical knowledge to a process.

Coordinate with reference lab sendout processes by creating manifests, organizing, and packaging specimens per requirements.
In core lab, measure 24-hour urine specimens, record measurements, and transfer aliquots to appropriately labeled tubes. If applicable, perform pH measurement and record results.
Support testing workflows by performing rapid testing, preparing gram stains, loading and unloading instruments, and plating/inoculating cultures to media for bacteriology/microbiology workups.
Record and enter appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.
Coordinate with physicians, nurses, phlebotomists, or units regarding specimen cancellation or recollection needs. Receive and help manage add-on testing requests and retrieve specimens as necessary.
Perform and document quality control, quality assurance activities, maintenance, and corrective actions related to quality and performance for tests within the lab assistant's scope.
Communicate effectively and courteously as part of the healthcare team. Support excellent service as defined by healthcare providers, patients, and others, and the [Company name masked] CARES initiative.

cond_0227.intro: This role will report to the Department Supervisor, accountable to the Operations Manager and Lab Director for the pre-analytical and post analytical specimen and result management in technical areas of the Laboratory. This role will perform a variety of routine and special processing procedures including and under the direction of the supervisor, waived testing. This position will liaison with clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals providing information and support to ensure proper collection, test orders, and handling of specimens for diagnostic analysis. This position requires a strong professional demeanor and strict attention to detail, multi-tasking abilities, great communication skills, and ability to apply technical acumen to a process. The Laboratory Assistant will be directly responsible for every patient specimen received into department, will accession specimens, verify specimens meet acceptability, and, if appropriate, will set up and or analyze samples as trained.
cond_0227.responsibilities:
Performs specimen triage, specimen identification, and properly accessions specimens using Epic.
Manage STAT and priority specimens, Evaluate specimen acceptability for testing ordered, and ensures receipt of specimens received from offsite locations and clients.
Maintains and operates laboratory equipment (as trained), and completes documentation as required.
Creates manifests for reference lab sendout testing, organizes and packages specimens per requirements.
In core lab, measures 24 hour urine specimens, records measurement and transfers aliquot to appropriately labeled tube. If applicable, performs pH measurement and records.
Performs rapid testing, prepares gram stains, load and unload instruments, plate/inoculate cultures to media for bacteriology/ microbiology workups and testing.
Records and enters appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.
Contacts physician, nurse, phlebotomist, or unit with instruction on specimen cancelation or recollection needs. Receives and manages add-on testing requests and retrieves specimens as necessary for testing.
Performs and documents quality control, quality assurance activities, maintenance, and corrective actions related to quality and performance for the tests responsible by the lab assistant.
Communicates effectively and courteously while working as a healthcare team member. Provides excellent service as defined by the customer (healthcare providers, patients, and others), and [Company name masked] CARES initiative.
Adherence to [Company name masked], CAP, TJC, CLIA, IDPH, HIPAA, and OSHA policies, procedures, and regulations.
Follows all security procedures concerning confidential patient information, both written and computerized.
Maintains adequate level of supplies, restocks as needed, and notifies supervisor of inventory needs.
Assists in training new employees as necessary.
Adheres to all [Company name masked] standards, policies, and procedures.
cond_0227.requirements:
Associate's degree in science or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Direct job experience equivalent to an Associate's degree may be considered.
Demonstrated expertise in clinical laboratory operations with specimen collection and testing required.
Proficiency in EPIC HIS preferred.
Proven track record of working effectively in a team environment.
Advanced knowledge of laboratory analytical instruments, cytology/Pap-smear processing, preferred.
Exceptional organizational skills necessary to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and complete work timely, effectively, and accurately.
Strong interpersonal skills necessary to interact effectively with physicians and hospital staff.
Ability to solve problems independently and seek out and perform additional tasks.
Normal color vision to allow employee to distinguish color differentiation of blood collection tubes, media, stained cells, or reagent labels.
Strong command of computer applications, especially MS Office and Epic HIS.
Able to stand for long periods of time, (5-8 hours).
Able to bend at knees, reach with arms, lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
Able to determine colors, have good dexterity, and legible handwriting.

cond_0273.intro: This role will report to the Department Supervisor, accountable to the Operations Manager and Lab Director for the pre-analytical and post analytical specimen and result management in technical areas of the Laboratory. This role will perform a variety of routine and special processing procedures including and under the direction of the supervisor, waived testing. This position will liaison with clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals providing information and support to ensure proper collection, test orders, and handling of specimens for diagnostic analysis. This position requires a strong professional demeanor and strict attention to detail, multi-tasking abilities, great communication skills, and ability to apply technical acumen to a process. The Laboratory Assistant will be directly responsible for every patient specimen received into department, will accession specimens, verify specimens meet acceptability, and, if appropriate, will set up and or analyze samples as trained.
cond_0273.responsibilities:
Performs specimen triage, specimen identification, and properly accessions specimens using Epic.
Manage STAT and priority specimens, Evaluate specimen acceptability for testing ordered, and ensures receipt of specimens received from offsite locations and clients.
Maintains and operates laboratory equipment (as trained), and completes documentation as required.
Creates manifests for reference lab sendout testing, organizes and packages specimens per requirements.
In core lab, measures 24 hour urine specimens, records measurement and transfers aliquot to appropriately labeled tube. If applicable, performs pH measurement and records.
Performs rapid testing, prepares gram stains, load and unload instruments, plate/inoculate cultures to media for bacteriology/ microbiology workups and testing.
Records and enters appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.
Contacts physician, nurse, phlebotomist, or unit with instruction on specimen cancelation or recollection needs. Receives and manages add-on testing requests and retrieves specimens as necessary for testing.
Performs and documents quality control, quality assurance activities, maintenance, and corrective actions related to quality and performance for the tests responsible by the lab assistant.
Communicates effectively and courteously while working as a healthcare team member. Provides excellent service as defined by the customer (healthcare providers, patients, and others), and [Company name masked] CARES initiative.
Adherence to [Company name masked], CAP, TJC, CLIA, IDPH, HIPAA, and OSHA policies, procedures, and regulations.
Follows all security procedures concerning confidential patient information, both written and computerized.
Maintains adequate level of supplies, restocks as needed, and notifies supervisor of inventory needs.
Assists in training new employees as necessary.
Adheres to all [Company name masked] standards, policies, and procedures.
Special Skills And Abilities Required
The organizational skills necessary to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and complete work timely, effectively, and accurately.
The interpersonal skills necessary to interact effectively with physicians and hospital staff.
Ability to solve problems and use problem solving abilities and able to seek out and perform additional tasks.
Normal color vision to allow employee to distinguish color differentiation of blood collection tubes, media, stained cells, or reagent labels.
Computer skills, especially with MS Office and Epic HIS.
Physical Requirements
Able to stand for long periods of time, (5-8 hours).
Able to bend at knees, reach with arms, lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
Able to determine colors, have good dexterity, and legible handwriting.
Working Conditions
Laboratory environment with chemical and biohazard materials/agents
cond_0273.requirements:

Associate's degree in science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Direct job experience equivalent to an Associate's degree may be considered.
Some background in clinical laboratory operations, including specimen collection and testing.
Experience working in a team environment.

Exposure to laboratory analytical instruments, cytology/Pap-smear processing.

The Laboratory Assistant is directly responsible for every patient specimen received into the department, including accessioning, verifying acceptability, and setting up or analyzing samples as trained. The role involves coordination with clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals to support proper collection, test orders, and specimen handling for diagnostic analysis. Strong attention to detail, multi-tasking ability, and technical acumen are essential.
cond_0313.responsibilities:
Performs specimen triage, specimen identification, and properly accessions specimens using Epic.
Manages STAT and priority specimens, evaluates specimen acceptability for testing ordered, and confirms receipt of specimens from offsite locations and clients.
Maintains and operates laboratory equipment (as trained) and completes required documentation.
Creates manifests for reference lab sendout testing, organizes and packages specimens per requirements.
In core lab, measures 24-hour urine specimens, records measurements, and transfers aliquots to appropriately labeled tubes. Performs pH measurement and records results where applicable.
Performs rapid testing, prepares gram stains, loads and unloads instruments, and plates/inoculates cultures to media for bacteriology/microbiology workups and testing.
Records and enters appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.
Contacts physician, nurse, phlebotomist, or unit with instructions on specimen cancellation or recollection needs. Receives and manages add-on testing requests and retrieves specimens as necessary.
Performs and documents quality control, quality assurance activities, maintenance, and corrective actions related to quality and performance for tests assigned to the lab assistant.
Coordinates with healthcare team members as required by task completion. Provides service in line with expectations of healthcare providers, patients, and others, and the [Company name masked] CARES initiative.
Adheres to [Company name masked], CAP, TJC, CLIA, IDPH, HIPAA, and OSHA policies, procedures, and regulations.
Follows all security procedures concerning confidential patient information, both written and computerized.
Maintains adequate supply levels, restocks as needed, and notifies supervisor of inventory needs.
Assists in training new employees as necessary.
Adheres to all [Company name masked] standards, policies, and procedures.
cond_0313.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in science or a related field. Direct job experience equivalent to an Associate's degree may be considered.
Demonstrated knowledge of clinical laboratory operations, including specimen collection and testing.
Organizational skills to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and complete work accurately and on time.
Normal color vision to distinguish color differentiation of blood collection tubes, media, stained cells, or reagent labels.
Ability to solve problems and seek out and perform additional tasks.
Computer skills, including MS Office and Epic HIS.
Physical ability to stand for long periods (5–8 hours), bend at knees, reach with arms, and lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
Ability to determine colors, maintain good dexterity, and produce legible handwriting.
Ability to work in a laboratory environment with chemical and biohazard materials/agents.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of EPIC HIS.
Experience working in a team environment.
Knowledge of laboratory analytical instruments, cytology, and Pap-smear processing.
The interpersonal skills necessary to coordinate effectively with physicians and hospital staff on task-specific needs are expected of all candidates.
cond_0313.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.
cond_0313.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.

cond_0338.intro: This role will report to the Department Supervisor, accountable to the Operations Manager and Lab Director for the pre-analytical and post analytical specimen and result management in technical areas of the Laboratory. This role will perform a variety of routine and special processing procedures including and under the direction of the supervisor, waived testing. This position will liaison with clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals providing information and support to ensure proper collection, test orders, and handling of specimens for diagnostic analysis. This position requires a strong professional demeanor and strict attention to detail, multi-tasking abilities, great communication skills, and ability to apply technical acumen to a process. The Laboratory Assistant will be directly responsible for every patient specimen received into department, will accession specimens, verify specimens meet acceptability, and, if appropriate, will set up and or analyze samples as trained. cond_0338.responsibilities:

Records and enters appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.

This position liaises with clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals to provide information and support to ensure proper collection, test orders, and handling of specimens for diagnostic analysis. This position requires a strong professional demeanor, strict attention to detail, multi-tasking abilities, good communication skills, and the ability to apply technical knowledge to a process. The Laboratory Assistant will be directly responsible for every patient specimen received into the department, will accession specimens, verify specimens meet acceptability, and, if appropriate, will set up and/or analyze samples as trained. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of specimen handling and laboratory workflows.
cond_0346.responsibilities:
Performs specimen triage, specimen identification, and properly accessions specimens using Epic.
Manage STAT and priority specimens, evaluate specimen acceptability for testing ordered, and ensures receipt of specimens received from offsite locations and clients.
Maintains and operates laboratory equipment (as trained), and completes documentation as required.
Creates manifests for reference lab sendout testing, organizes and packages specimens per requirements.
In core lab, measures 24 hour urine specimens, records measurement and transfers aliquot to appropriately labeled tube. If applicable, performs pH measurement and records.
Performs rapid testing, prepares gram stains, load and unload instruments, plate/inoculate cultures to media for bacteriology/microbiology workups and testing.
Records and enters appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.
Contacts physician, nurse, phlebotomist, or unit with instruction on specimen cancelation or recollection needs. Receives and manages add-on testing requests and retrieves specimens as necessary for testing.
Performs and documents quality control, quality assurance activities, maintenance, and corrective actions related to quality and performance for the tests responsible by the lab assistant.
Communicates effectively and courteously while working as a healthcare team member. Provides excellent service as defined by the customer (healthcare providers, patients, and others), and [Company name masked] CARES initiative.
Adherence to [Company name masked], CAP, TJC, CLIA, IDPH, HIPAA, and OSHA policies, procedures, and regulations.
Follows all security procedures concerning confidential patient information, both written and computerized.
Maintains adequate level of supplies, restocks as needed, and notifies supervisor of inventory needs.
Assists in training new employees as necessary.
Adheres to all [Company name masked] standards, policies, and procedures.
Special Skills and Abilities:
The organizational skills necessary to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and complete work timely, effectively, and accurately.
The interpersonal skills necessary to interact effectively with physicians and hospital staff.
Ability to solve problems and use problem solving abilities and able to seek out and perform additional tasks.
Normal color vision to allow employee to distinguish color differentiation of blood collection tubes, media, stained cells, or reagent labels.
Computer skills, especially with MS Office and Epic HIS.
Physical Requirements:
Able to stand for long periods of time, (5-8 hours).
Able to bend at knees, reach with arms, lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
Able to determine colors, have good dexterity, and legible handwriting.
Working Conditions:
Laboratory environment with chemical and biohazard materials/agents.
cond_0346.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in science or related field. Direct job experience equivalent to an Associate's degree may be considered.
Demonstrated knowledge of clinical laboratory operations with specimen collection and testing.
Experience working in a team environment.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of EPIC HIS.
Knowledge of laboratory analytical instruments, cytology/Pap-smear processing.
cond_0346.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.

This position will regularly liaise with clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals, providing information and support to ensure proper collection, test orders, and handling of specimens for diagnostic analysis. This position requires a strong professional demeanor and strict attention to detail, multi-tasking abilities, great communication skills, and ability to apply technical acumen to a process. The Laboratory Assistant will be directly responsible for every patient specimen received into department, will accession specimens, verify specimens meet acceptability, and, if appropriate, will set up and or analyze samples as trained.
cond_0510.responsibilities:
Performs specimen triage, specimen identification, and properly accessions specimens using Epic.
Manage STAT and priority specimens, evaluate specimen acceptability for testing ordered, and ensures receipt of specimens received from offsite locations and clients.
Maintains and operates laboratory equipment (as trained), and completes documentation as required.
Creates manifests for reference lab sendout testing, organizes and packages specimens per requirements.
In core lab, measures 24 hour urine specimens, records measurement and transfers aliquot to appropriately labeled tube. If applicable, performs pH measurement and records.
Performs rapid testing, prepares gram stains, load and unload instruments, plate/inoculate cultures to media for bacteriology/microbiology workups and testing.
Records and enters appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.
Contacts physician, nurse, phlebotomist, or unit with instruction on specimen cancelation or recollection needs. Receives and manages add-on testing requests and retrieves specimens as necessary for testing.
Performs and documents quality control, quality assurance activities, maintenance, and corrective actions related to quality and performance for the tests responsible by the lab assistant.
Communicates effectively and courteously while working as a healthcare team member, staying in regular contact with healthcare providers, patients, and others. Provides excellent service as defined by the customer and the [Company name masked] CARES initiative.
Adherence to [Company name masked], CAP, TJC, CLIA, IDPH, HIPAA, and OSHA policies, procedures, and regulations.
Follows all security procedures concerning confidential patient information, both written and computerized.
Maintains adequate level of supplies, restocks as needed, and notifies supervisor of inventory needs.
Assists in training new employees as necessary.
Adheres to all [Company name masked] standards, policies, and procedures.
cond_0510.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in science or related field. Direct job experience equivalent to an Associate's degree may be considered.
Demonstrated knowledge of clinical laboratory operations with specimen collection and testing.
Experience working in a team environment.
The organizational skills necessary to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and complete work timely, effectively, and accurately.
The interpersonal skills necessary to interact effectively with physicians and hospital staff on a regular basis.
Ability to solve problems and seek out and perform additional tasks.
Normal color vision to allow employee to distinguish color differentiation of blood collection tubes, media, stained cells, or reagent labels.
Computer skills, especially with MS Office and Epic HIS.
Able to stand for long periods of time (5–8 hours).
Able to bend at knees, reach with arms, lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
Able to determine colors, have good dexterity, and legible handwriting.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of EPIC HIS.
Knowledge of laboratory analytical instruments, cytology/Pap-smear processing.
cond_0510.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0510.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.

This position will liaison with clinical staff, physicians, pathologists, and other professionals providing information and support to ensure proper collection, test orders, and handling of specimens for diagnostic analysis. This position requires a strong professional demeanor and strict attention to detail, multi-tasking abilities, great communication skills, and ability to apply technical acumen to a process. The Laboratory Assistant will be directly responsible for every patient specimen received into department, will accession specimens, verify specimens meet acceptability, and, if appropriate, will set up and or analyze samples as trained.
cond_0587.responsibilities:
Performs specimen triage, specimen identification, and properly accessions specimens using Epic.
Manage STAT and priority specimens, Evaluate specimen acceptability for testing ordered, and ensures receipt of specimens received from offsite locations and clients.
Maintains and operates laboratory equipment (as trained), and completes documentation as required.
Creates manifests for reference lab sendout testing, organizes and packages specimens per requirements.
In core lab, measures 24 hour urine specimens, records measurement and transfers aliquot to appropriately labeled tube. If applicable, performs pH measurement and records.
Performs rapid testing, prepares gram stains, load and unload instruments, plate/inoculate cultures to media for bacteriology/ microbiology workups and testing.
Records and enters appropriate patient and physician data needed to complete testing.
Contacts physician, nurse, phlebotomist, or unit with instruction on specimen cancelation or recollection needs. Receives and manages add-on testing requests and retrieves specimens as necessary for testing.
Performs and documents quality control, quality assurance activities, maintenance, and corrective actions related to quality and performance for the tests responsible by the lab assistant.
Communicates effectively and courteously while working as a healthcare team member. Provides excellent service as defined by the customer (healthcare providers, patients, and others), and [Company name masked] CARES initiative.
Adherence to [Company name masked], CAP, TJC, CLIA, IDPH, HIPAA, and OSHA policies, procedures, and regulations.
Follows all security procedures concerning confidential patient information, both written and computerized.
Maintains adequate level of supplies, restocks as needed, and notifies supervisor of inventory needs.
Assists in training new employees as necessary.
Adheres to all [Company name masked] standards, policies, and procedures.
cond_0587.requirements:
Associate's degree in science or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Direct job experience equivalent to an Associate's degree may be considered.
Demonstrated expertise in clinical laboratory operations with specimen collection and testing required.
Proficiency in EPIC HIS preferred.
Proven track record of working effectively in a team environment.
Advanced knowledge of laboratory analytical instruments, cytology/Pap-smear processing, preferred.
Exceptional organizational skills necessary to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and complete work timely, effectively, and accurately.
Strong interpersonal skills necessary to interact effectively with physicians and hospital staff.
Ability to solve problems independently and seek out and perform additional tasks.
Normal color vision to allow employee to distinguish color differentiation of blood collection tubes, media, stained cells, or reagent labels.
Strong command of computer applications, especially MS Office and Epic HIS.
Able to stand for long periods of time, (5-8 hours).
Able to bend at knees, reach with arms, lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
Able to determine colors, have good dexterity, and legible handwriting.
cond_0587.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0587.inclusion: Achieving a 50/50 gender balance reflects [Company name masked]'s core values and business philosophy and is essential for our future success. Our commitment to equal gender representation across all levels allows us to create an environment where every employee can bring their unique perspective and experiences to work, enabling us to drive profitability, increase productivity, and unleash innovation. We strive to create a workplace that is equitable and accessible to all employees.
